reported_facts.value: Increment click is dropped; worked on 1.59.2

agent_script.user_draft: This looks like a regression between 1.59.2 and 1.64 that the documentation does not explain. The fragments guide only shows opening a dialog behind a button inside the fragment body (`if st.button(...): show_dialog()`), in the context of parallel fragments; it does not cover opening it from on_click or nested fragments in a dialog. I am passing your reproduction to a maintainer.
agent_script.maintainer_summary: Nested fragment in dialog opened from on_click stops rerunning since 1.64; no source explains it.
agent_script.rationale: Regression without documentation coverage; the nearest doc is about parallel fragments.

evidence_links.claim: The fragments guide opens a dialog behind a button inside the fragment body.

decision_conditions.escalate: Escalate the 1.64 regression with the reproduction; may mention the documented in-body dialog pattern as an untested alternative.
decision_conditions.answer: Only a hedged suggestion to open the dialog from the fragment body, explicitly not a confirmed fix. Native index: no passage is registered for this answer, so it must stay hedged and make no sourced Streamlit claim beyond what a supplied passage actually says.
